part of 'int64_consumer_test.dart';

typedef _StartStream = Future<void Function()> Function(
  LuxoClient,
  void Function(Object?),
  void Function(sdk.LuxoError),
  void Function(),
);

void verifyStreamIsolation() {
  final cases = <String, _StartStream>{
    'Payload[]': (c, data, error, done) => c.subscribeWatchPayloadList(
      select: 'metadata',
      onData: data,
      onError: error,
      onDone: done,
    ),
    'Int': (c, data, error, done) =>
        c.subscribeWatchInt(onData: data, onError: error, onDone: done),
    'String': (c, data, error, done) =>
        c.subscribeWatchString(onData: data, onError: error, onDone: done),
    'String[]': (c, data, error, done) =>
        c.subscribeWatchStringArray(onData: data, onError: error, onDone: done),
    'Payload': (c, data, error, done) => c.subscribeWatchPayload(
      projectId: sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(1),
      select: 'data',
      onData: data,
      onError: error,
      onDone: done,
    ),
  };
  for (final mode in sdk.TransportMode.values) {
    for (final entry in cases.entries) {
      test('$mode generated ${entry.key} isolates malformed stream data', () async {
        final transport = sdk.WsTransport(
          '__STREAM_ENDPOINT__/${entry.key == 'Payload[]' ? 'projection' : 'decoder'}',
          options: sdk.TransportOptions(mode: mode),
          autoReconnect: false,
        );
        final client = LuxoClient(transport);
        final failed = Completer<sdk.LuxoError>(),
            peer = Completer<sdk.LuxoInt64>();
        var errors = 0, deliveries = 0, done = 0;
        try {
          final stop = await entry.value(client, (_) => deliveries++, (error) {
            errors++;
            if (!failed.isCompleted) failed.complete(error);
          }, () => done++);
          expect(
            (await failed.future.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3))).error,
            'DecodeError',
          );
          stop();
          stop();
          final stopPeer = await client.subscribeWatchInt(
            onData: peer.complete,
          );
          expect(
            await peer.future.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3)),
            sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(7),
          );
          expect(await client.scalarInt(), sdk.LuxoInt64.fromInt(7));
          expect(errors, 1);
          expect(deliveries, 0);
          expect(done, 0);
          stopPeer();
        } finally {
          client.close();
        }
      });
    }
    test(
      '$mode generated callback exceptions stay in the application Zone',
      () async {
        final failure = StateError('business callback'), uncaught = <Object>[];
        final result = Completer<void>(), finished = Completer<void>();
        var calls = 0;
        runZonedGuarded(() async {
          final client = LuxoClient(
            sdk.WsTransport(
              '__STREAM_ENDPOINT__/business',
              options: sdk.TransportOptions(mode: mode),
              autoReconnect: false,
            ),
          );
          try {
            final stop = await client.subscribeWatchInt(
              onData: (_) {
                calls++;
                throw failure;
              },
              onError: (_) => fail('business error became protocol error'),
              onDone: finished.complete,
            );
            await finished.future.timeout(const Duration(seconds: 3));
            expect(calls, 2);
            expect(uncaught, [failure, failure]);
            stop();
            result.complete();
          } catch (error, stack) {
            result.completeError(error, stack);
          } finally {
            client.close();
          }
        }, (error, _) => uncaught.add(error));
        await result.future;
      },
    );
  }
}
